description: 单表过滤、常量折叠、投影裁剪、排序与 LIMIT
sql: SELECT id, name AS employee_name, salary + (10 * 2 - 20) AS adjusted_salary FROM employees WHERE active = 1 AND salary >= 70000 AND name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY salary DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5

description: 多表 INNER JOIN，谓词分别下推到两侧 Scan
sql: SELECT e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.active = 1 AND d.region = 'East' ORDER BY e.name LIMIT 10

description: GROUP BY、聚合、HAVING、别名排序与 LIMIT
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS headcount, SUM(e.salary) AS payroll FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.active = 1 GROUP BY d.name HAVING SUM(e.salary) > 100000 ORDER BY payroll DESC LIMIT 5

description: LEFT JOIN 上仅左表谓词可安全下推，右表谓词保留在 Join 之上
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, e.name AS employee_name FROM departments AS d LEFT JOIN employees AS e ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.active = 1 ORDER BY d.name, e.name LIMIT 20

description: ORDER BY 使用未投影列与 IN 列表，投影裁剪必须保留排序键
sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE active = 1 AND salary IN (72000, 98000, 115000) ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3

description: 聚合查询引用未分组列，应返回 E_INVALID_AGGREGATE
sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, e.name AS employee_name, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON e.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name
